title: UserPosture
description: The structured expression of a principal's Binding (v0.4). Declares constraints within which an agent's proposals are considered within scope. Must be signed. Must remain within OrgPolicy.absolute_constraints.

version.description: Semver version of this posture declaration, e.g. '1.0'.

principal_id.description: Identity of the principal declaring this posture.

intent_statement.description: Human-readable statement of delegation intent. Signed as part of the posture.

simulation_ref.description: Reference to the PostureSimulationResult used at signing time. Required — prevents Binding Theater.

history.description: Immutable history of previous posture versions. Entries MUST NOT be deleted.

posture_signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 or HMAC-SHA256 signature over canonical_content() (excludes posture_signature itself).

PostureConstraints.title: PostureConstraints
PostureConstraints.description: Constraints declared by a principal. These define the boundary of actions the principal accepts responsibility for. Must remain within OrgPolicy.absolute_constraints.

target_scope.description: Regex or glob pattern for allowed targets. e.g. 'host:dev-*'. Proposals with non-matching targets receive Layer 1 REJECT.

max_blast_radius.description: Maximum blast radius this principal accepts responsibility for. Proposals exceeding this receive Layer 1 REJECT.

reversibility_required.description: If true, irreversible proposals receive Layer 1 REJECT.

minimum_evidence.description: Minimum number of evidence items required. Proposals with fewer items receive Layer 1 REJECT.

PostureHistoryEntry.title: PostureHistoryEntry
PostureHistoryEntry.description: Immutable record of a previous posture version. Must not be deleted.

examples.intent_statement: I delegate automated remediation to this agent for dev environments only.
